 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Two different realities. Tigres have nothing to play for in the penultimate round of the Mexican league, while Cruz Azul are fighting to finish top of the overall standings.
 Tigres are enduring a campaign to forget, missing out on the playoffs for the first time in years. Visiting El Volcán is never easy, but Tigres are far from their best right now.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tigres' starting XI
 Cruz Azul are level on points with América and Chivas, so an away win would move them closer to securing top spot overall.
 La Máquina's starting XI
 Tigres come into this game winless in four matches. Can they end their poor run against La Máquina, or will they keep sinking at the bottom of the overall standings?
